capabilities: Generate atomic notes from conversations, files, clipboard text, and web article URLs via an LLM
Generate metadata, keywords, tags, and timestamps for each note automatically
Create bidirectional wikilinks between related notes using embedding-based nearest-neighbor retrieval
Answer questions over the notes with a sidebar chatbot that cites its sources
Maintain a MOC file and a persisted semantic index in the vault
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README warns that source text and note metadata are sent to the configured chat/embedding services, that API keys are stored in plugin data rather than the system keychain, and that long files can trigger many billed API requests; it recommends testing in a scratch vault first. The README is bilingual (English and Chinese).
problem: Building a Zettelkasten by hand is slow: extracting atomic notes, writing tags and metadata, and finding which existing notes each new note should link to all require manual effort.

relations.evidence: Inspired by A-MEM: Agentic Memory for LLM Agents, it automatically generates metadata and tags
relations.plugin: A-MEM: Agentic Memory for LLM Agents

relations.evidence: no local ChromaDB or sentence-transformers service is required

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible chat and embedding API key

summary: AI plugin that uses an LLM to turn conversations, vault files, clipboard text, and web articles into linked atomic notes with A-mem-style retrieval and evolution.
